content: उन्मन्थनम् .²1 Shaking off, agitating. .²2 Killing, slaughter; अन्योन्यसूतोन्मथनादभूताम् <ls>R. 7. 52</ls>; hurting; मारीचदर्शनं चैव सीतोन्मथनमेव च <ls>Rām. 6. 124. 11</ls>. .²3 Beating (with a stick). .²4 Probing, stirring a dart lodged in the body. .²5 The instrument used for this purpose. .²6 Churning up; कौर्मे धृतोऽद्रिरमृतोन्मथने स्वपृष्ठे <ls>Bhāg. 11. 4. 18</ls>.
